description: This file defines the SugarpdfFactory class which is responsible for loading and instantiating different Sugarpdf classes based on specified parameters. It contains methods for dynamically including specific PHP files for PDF generation modules, and for building class instances of those modules. It also manages default fallbacks to a generic Sugarpdf class if specific classes are not found.

classes.name: SugarpdfFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading, including, and instantiating various Sugarpdf subclasses based on parameters and available files.

methods.name: loadSugarpdf
methods.description: Loads and returns a Sugarpdf object of the appropriate type, based on the given parameters and available files, with fallbacks to a default Sugarpdf instance.

methods.name: _buildFromFile
methods.description: Private helper method that requires a PHP file, constructs the class name, and returns an instance of that class if it exists or defaults to Sugarpdf.

methods.name: _buildClass
methods.description: Private helper method that instantiates a class of a given name, passing in the bean and object map, with fallback to a generic Sugarpdf.
